TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd is a SECP-incorporated Pakistani company established in 2012, with active tax registrations (FBR NTN/ATL and Punjab & Sindh sales tax) and offices in Islamabad (HQ), Lahore and Karachi [CO-PROFILE]. We bring relevant delivery experience across Federal and Provincial Government, Private Sector and International clients [CO-PROFILE], including road construction deployments completed for Provincial Government (PKR 199M, 2022; PKR 163M, ISO 9001, 2019) and Federal Government (PKR 177M, ISO 27001, 2020) [CAP-015][CAP-039][CAP-003]. For the “Including Three Bridges” component, we have multiple bridge engineering deployments completed up to PKR 200M (International, 2023) and Federal Government assignments completed in 2024 and 2025 [CAP-028][CAP-040][CAP-004].

For Package-IV’s 24-month period (including two monsoon seasons), our proposal will include a detailed construction methodology and a CPM-based work program aligned to KPPRA single stage one envelope requirements [CO-PROFILE]. We will also provide the required bid security (PKR 37 million) via CDR/bank guarantee; our bank guarantee facility is PKR 100 million [CO-PROFILE].

We are transparent on mandatory eligibility gaps: our library does not yet evidence PEC constructor registration in category C-A/C-1, ISO 14001 certification, three road contracts ≥ PKR 700 million each, or average annual turnover ≥ PKR 1,500 million (our evidenced average is PKR 900 million) [CO-PROFILE]. We will address these through compliant partnering/JV arrangements and by proposing an ISO 14001-certified environmental management partner for works in protected watershed zones [CO-PROFILE].

Our commitment is disciplined delivery, documented HSE practices, and a zero reportable fatality record supported by site safety plans on infrastructure deployments [CO-PROFILE].
